task: FV2-018 — Flutter frameless desktop window chrome and text-only brand
summary: Added a compact draggable desktop title bar for macOS and Windows, hid the native title bar, preserved macOS traffic lights, added Windows window controls, and kept mobile layout unchanged. The brand is a legible Inter wordmark without an icon.

checks.observation: Covers Windows controls and actions, text-only Inter wordmark styling with no icon, macOS native-control inset, and no title bar on Android.

checks.observation: Built only; the running macOS app was not restarted.

checks.name: Title-bar visual review
checks.observation: Rendered a temporary 1000x32 Windows title-bar capture with the bundled Inter font and inspected it at native and enlarged scale. BOOHTACORD is readable and has no icon; the temporary generated capture was not retained in the repository.

checks.name: Live macOS window visual acceptance
checks.observation: Inspected the already-running macOS Debug window without restarting it. The system title text is replaced by the 32 px custom bar; BOOHTACORD is text-only and the three native traffic-light window controls remain visible. A double-click maximized the window and a second double-click restored its original size; the chat was returned to its prior latest-message position. No screenshot was retained because the current workspace contains user conversation content.
